## What's new
- **Update notice.** If you installed Intent Tab from the ZIP file, it now checks GitHub once a day and shows a small card when a newer version is out, with a Download button and how to update. (Copies from the Chrome Web Store update themselves and skip this.) Only the version number is fetched; nothing about you is sent.

## Install / update
1. Download `intent-tab-v1.3.0.zip` below.
2. Already installed? Unzip it **into the same folder as before** (replace the old files), then click ↻ on Intent Tab at `chrome://extensions`. Your data stays.
3. New install: unzip anywhere, open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the folder.

From this version on, you'll be told inside Intent Tab whenever an update is out.

Video guide (Bangla): https://saykatghosh.github.io/intent_tab/#video
